name: gta-face-clipper-mern
description: GTA Face Clipper rewritten on the MERN stack: live GTA stream discovery, highlight clipping and vertical facecam-over-gameplay rendering.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run setup:ytdlp --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
